entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: The blue-aligned court of the Realm on Eldraine, exemplifying Knowledge and led by the Magic Mirror.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane on which Vantress lies.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: A neighboring court abandoned by Will Kenrith.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Planeswalker and acting king who moved his seat to Vantress.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: A sentient magic mirror that leads Vantress, answers one question in exchange for an unknown secret, and was stolen after the invasion.

entities.name: Gadwick
entities.description: The archmage of Vantress who handles day-to-day responsibilities.

entities.name: Caervelin
entities.description: Tower and residence of Gadwick and Johann, accidentally burned down.

entities.name: Castle Vantress
entities.description: The court's castle on Lochmere, later a floating castle.

entities.name: Delverhaugh
entities.description: An underground dwarven fortress where a Grand Ball was raided by redcaps.

entities.name: Lochmere
entities.description: A mist-shrouded lake with undines, in which Castle Vantress stands.

entities.name: Undines
entities.description: Beings living in Lochmere who ferry travelers across.

entities.name: Loremages
entities.description: Vantress wizards who seek lore of the Wilds and fae magic.

entities.name: Beluna Grandsquall
entities.description: Owner of Stormkeld castle, to which Indrelon was moved.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Lochmere was flooded and all courts fell.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A slumber spreading across the plane, whose victims Vantress wizards study.

entities.name: Elven Lords
entities.description: Rulers who enslaved mankind until overthrown.

events.summary: Eight or nine generations before the Wildered Quest, mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Vantress is established around Indrelon.
events.quote: The court of Vantress was established around Indrelon .

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Lochmere is flooded, much of the castle destroyed, and all courts fall.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Lochmere was flooded, destroying much of the castle.

events.summary: Indrelon is stolen and moved to Stormkeld; Will Kenrith abandons Ardenvale for Vantress and has wizards encase Wicked Slumber victims in glass caskets.
events.quote: Indrelon was stolen from Castle Vantress and moved to Beluna Grandsquall 's castle, Stormkeld.

relations.quote: most of the day-to-day responsibilities are tended to by the archmage, currently Gadwick .

relations.note: The people are led by the Magic Mirror
relations.quote: the people of Vantress are led by the Magic Mirror itself
the residence of Gadwick and his apprentice Johann
the current seat of acting king Will Kenrith

relations.note: Castle sits at the center of the lake
relations.quote: The castle itself sits at the center of the lake Lochmere
